body:
⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md`. This is **`domain:ui` seat 1**, the lane's first post on this board: objectui became this repository's `ui/` workspace (#25825), and the lane's former post lived on the objectui board, which this seat cannot reach. No `domain:ui` post existed in the `pm:seat` index here (open or closed) when this one was raised.

- **Current PM:** 🟢 `os-steve` · 由 os-steve 账户的项目负责 (the Claude Code project "objectstack", seat thread "接管 ui 车道派发") · `session_017iXjUm1rujwDk7f3KT1Pkk`, seated on the maintainer's word in that project (「你开始负责 ui 车道，并发10」, 2026-10-26T06:20Z). Mutex readings at seating: no prior `domain:ui` post, no open `pm:dispatched` card in the lane, no assignee on any open lane card.
- **Second seat:** `domain:ui` seat 2 = #25995 (maintainer's word, 2026-10-26). The split is by the fix's landing package. Seat 2 holds plugin-list / grid / detail / form / view / kanban / calendar / gantt / map / timeline / tree / charts / dashboard / report and `fields`. After the 09:18Z rebalance it also holds the auth pages (login / register / invitation), the app-shell Setup / admin pages, marketplace and the console sidebar. Seat 1 holds everything else: i18n packs, `components` (form.tsx), Studio / designer, AI chat and build, approvals, tech-debt. Cards on one file stay with one seat and land in order.
- **Hot-file serial queue:** `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are ⛔ out of bounds for every ui card for now (the ui-merge `pm:epic` subtree under #25677 is editing them; maintainer's word in the project). **Manifest records are per package** since #26120 (#26051) merged at 13:49Z, and the single token is retired. A PR enqueues once every earlier PR that shares a registry package with it (non-test `src/` under `ui/packages/PKG`) has MERGED. A PR that changes `sdui.manifest.json` itself re-records every package and stays globally serial. Order by package (both seats, 17:20Z): i18n: #26202 (re-queued) → #26055; plugin-detail: #26060 MERGED → #26055 → #26277 (#26182); react: #25917 (building); plugin-grid: #26050; app-shell `index.ts`: #25922 (#26219, main merged, Blocked-by #26220). The queue squash-merges, so a same-package train is batched by folding the PRs into one, not by stacking them. Every open PR first merges `origin/main` once (taking main's `record.json`) and regenerates. Other lanes: only a PR on the same package needs to wait. PRs that change no registry package (app-shell, plugin-chatbot, apps/console) queue freely after merging the latest `origin/main` and building. `ObjectView.tsx`: #25992 slice 2 (#26233) in flight, so no other seat 1 card edits it. Main's Test UI was red 15:38–17:10Z on an exact ObjectSchema key-count pin (#26005 → #26218/#26231); the structural fix is #26238 (seat 2). Chat hydration: #25908 (blocked on cloud#3292) follows #25887 (landed).
- **In flight (2026-10-26T20:15Z):** in the merge queue: #26276 (#26290). Awaiting arm: #25911 slice 1b (#26309). Waiting on a line: #26182 (#26277, contract review PASS; plugin-detail after seat 2's #26055) · #26183 (#26262, re-merging after #26202) · #25994 slice 1 (plugin-grid after seat 2's #25884). Held on #26220: #25922 (#26219) · #25918 partial (#26293). Taken over as the blocked seat: #26220 (the ADR-0087 gate learns ui roots, alias/shim/.tsx and any index signatures; reviewed by devx seat 2). Building: #26275 (51 spec-union type pins) · #25917 (react off the ObjectStack adapter, #26292) · #25992 slice 3. Blocked: #25872 (ruling B) on the spec card #26304 (knocked on #18549). One card thread each, readings on the cards. Order rule (maintainer, 17:26Z): priority first across the lane. Landed today: #25858 · #25871 · #25874 · #25877 · #25887 · #25888 · #25890 · #25892 · #25894 · #25897 · #25898 · #25899 · #25900 · #25901 · #25925 · #25938 · #25999 · #26126 · #26131 · #26172 · #26194 · #26199, plus #25915 slices 1–2, #25992 slices 1–2, #25911 slice 1a and the #25921 dead-keys slice. Filed: #26131 · #26199 · #26220 · #26304 · #26306. Waiting on others: #25934 (needs-user-decision), #26190 (Blocked-by #26189, server), #25943 (cloud card).

- **Pointer:** posture and ledger live in the project; canonical ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` comments + `head:claude/` PRs, read by `assignee:os-steve`.
